name: cadoxide
description: CADoxide — 100% Pure Rust WASM + Instanced GPU SDF Hardware Collaboration Platform

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --offline --manifest-path crates/cadoxide-wasm/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --no-typescript --out-dir public/wasm crates/cadoxide-wasm/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/cadoxide_wasm.wasm
